entries: New corridor analysis page: the stretches of road with the most recorded pedestrian and cyclist crashes, and whether any tracked project falls within 100 m of them.

Crash records are grouped by VDOT's own route name, then cut into stretches wherever there is a gap of more than 300 m between crashes on that road — a whole road like US 250 runs nine miles and one answer for all of it would mean nothing.
Crash counts are not a measure of danger, and "no tracked project" means only that this site has no record of one. Both limits are stated above the table, not after it.
Address search on the map, a text filter on the project list, and satellite links on project pages.
All six example projects replaced with 7 real Three Chopt District projects, extracted from the county's "Word on the Street" newsletters (March–September 2024).
Project locations resolved from OpenStreetMap intersection nodes and way geometry, each verified to fall inside the county boundary and to sit on the roads the county named.
Two projects are listed without a map location: a countywide signal program with no single site, and one intersection that could not be resolved confidently.
Site launched. 6 example projects pending replacement with verified county data.
Crash layer: 540 pedestrian- and bicyclist-involved crashes in Henrico, 2021–2025, from VDOT's CrashData basic dataset.
School layer: 68 school locations from Henrico County GIS.
